page.layout: One printed page (left) with running text in one column, page number and running head at top; a narrow column of marginal notes on the right edge (partly cut off by the binding/fold), in small type. Main text is a dictionary of Greek and Latin names.

main_text.p: tus. Genit. τοῦ Λάζι, Luc.3.24. in Accus.Λάζιν Luc.3.27.
Λάζιτης ὁ Levita. Λαζιτικὸς ἢ ὂν Leviticus a um.
Λιβύη ης ἡ nomen regionis, Africa à nomine Λίβυς υ ὁ Afer, Poenus.
Λυκάς ὁ nomen viri, Latin. à luce, quòd prima luce, hoc est, sole oriente nati sic dicerentur.
Λάχιος ὁ nomen propheta Act.13.1. Rom.16. v.21. similiter dictus à luce.
Λύδδα ης ἡ nomen urbis in Judaea dicta à Lud filio Semi.
Λυδία ας ἡ nomen mulieris à Lydia regione.
Λυκαονία ας ἡ nomen regionis in Asia, Gr. Lupina.
Λυσανίας ὁ nomen praefecti Romani, Gr. disfolvens moleftiam.
Λυσίας ὁ nomen viri, Gr. disfolvens.
Λύστρα ας ἡ nomen urbis, Λύστρα ὣν τὸ idem.
Λωΐς ἡ nomen pia matrona, quae fuit Timothei avia, Gr. melior.
Λῶτ ὁ nomen viri ἀκλιτον, abfconditus.
main_text.head: M.
main_text.p: Μαὰδ ὁ nomen viri ἀκλίτον, Heb. vacillans.
Μαγδαλὰ ἡ nomen loci, Hebr. turris.
Μαγδαλῶν ης ἡ nomen mul. Syr. magnifica.

page.notes: Right margin: a column of partly cut-off marginal notes in small type (Greek and Latin glosses, e.g. "nomen praepos.", "forma", "mortem pellens", "done", "Macedonicus", "longitudo", "habitatio", "faciens oblivisci", "tellantur Marti", "datus", "Marcus", etc.); these are fragmentary and largely illegible because the page edge is cut off, so they are not transcribed. Greek and some Hebrew readings are approximate; the page has a Hebrew word on the Heb. lines and Syriac on the Syr. line.
